title: Locator
description: One place in an original (D13, E17): the single shape every citation, Suggestion evidence and evidence Relation uses. Anchored to a Blob by its sha256, or for media_time to a Capture's recording timeline. Pages and slides count from 1; other indexes count from 0. When the precise place is unknown the Hub writes document and does not guess. The Hub makes Locators: an LLM cites only the ContentBlock ids it was given, and the Hub checks those ids and turns them into Locators. Open, as the Hub sends it: a known kind is checked by its branch (known), and an unknown kind matching the name pattern is kept with whatever members it has; a client shows it as document-level evidence when it has a blob and as evidence of unknown place otherwise. v is at least 1 and may grow. Input that carries a Locator uses the closed view input (D20).

kind.description: Known kinds are the examples; a newer Hub may send others (#17 adds annotation).

version.description: Version of the Locator shapes; this contract defines 1 (E17), and a newer Hub may send a higher one.

blob.description: The Blob the place is in.

ordinal.description: Counted from 1, as the user sees it; PDFKit's 0-based pages are converted at the client.

known.description: The known kinds as a discriminated union. Each branch is open to new members.

input.description: The closed view for input: only the known kinds, and v is 1. Nothing a client sends carries a Locator yet; the first input that does uses this view.

pdf_page.description: A page of a PDF, optionally one region of it.

slide.description: A slide of a presentation, optionally one shape on it.

shape.description: The shape's position in the slide's shape tree in document order, from 1.

doc_path.description: A block of a word-processor document, found by the headings above it.

heading_path.description: Heading texts from the outermost in; empty for blocks before the first heading.

block_index.description: The block's index under the last heading of heading_path, from 0.

sheet_range.description: A cell or a rectangular range of one sheet.

sheet.description: The sheet's name, as a spreadsheet allows it: 1 to 31 characters, none of \\ / ? * [ ] : or a control character, not starting or ending with an apostrophe.

a1.description: A cell or a first:last range in A1 notation, uppercase, without $, inside the grid (columns to XFD, rows to 1048576), from the top-left cell to the bottom-right one (rule a1_order).

media_time.description: A span, or with start_ms = end_ms an instant, of a Capture's recording timeline: the segments joined in order (D15), not a processing chunk's offset.

image_region.description: A region of an image, in the image as displayed after its EXIF rotation.

web_snapshot.description: A place in a stored web page snapshot; the snapshot Blob is the anchor. A URL without a snapshot is cited as document.

url.description: The page the snapshot was taken from, in the form Capture url takes.

anchor.description: A fragment id inside the page, without #.

document.description: The whole original, when no finer place is known.
